rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for damaging or breaking a concrete object, especially through handling or use.

example.english: Please don't damage my phone again.
example.traditional: 你唔好再整壞部手機喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zing2 waai6 bou6 sau2 gei1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the damage involves destroying or seriously disrupting a structure, environment, system, or arrangement.

example.english: Changing things randomly will damage the whole plan.
example.traditional: 亂咁改會破壞成個計劃㗎。
example.jyutping: lyun6 gam2 goi2 wui5 po3 waai6 seng4 go3 gai3 waak6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this mainly for harming the value, quality, interests, health, or soundness of something rather than physically breaking it.

example.english: This policy will damage the interests of small businesses.
example.traditional: 呢項政策會損害小商戶嘅利益。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 wui5 syun2 hoi6 siu2 soeng1 wu6 ge3 lei6 jik1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical damage to an object or thing.

example.english: The damage to the phone is pretty serious.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 syun2 waai6 gei2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use this when the damage means harm or injury to a person or living being.

example.english: This accident caused serious damage to him.
example.traditional: 呢次意外對佢造成好大傷害。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ji3 ngoi6 deoi3 keoi5 zou6 sing4 hou2 daai6 soeng1 hoi6

rows.note: Use this for the cost or expense itself rather than a bill document.

example.english: The damage for repairing the air conditioner was more than I expected.
example.traditional: 維修冷氣機嘅費用，比我預期中多。
example.jyutping: wai4 sau1 laang5 hei3 gei1 ge3 fai3 jung6 bei2 ngo5 jyu6 kei4 zung1 do1

rows.note: Use this when the damage means the bill or written amount to pay.

example.english: The damage bill for the car came to over a thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 部車整花咗，帳單成千蚊。
example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 zing2 faa1 zo2 zoeng3 daan1 sing4 cin1 man1
